result:
As a thought experiment, if I could change the world in one way, I would ensure that everyone in the world has access to a safe, reliable, and abundant source of clean water.

I would make it possible for human beings to live without the burden of water scarcity, no matter where they are in the world. No more walking miles for a single drop, no more worrying about where the next cup of clean water will come from. Every person, no matter their background, social status, or location, would have access to clean drinking water, sanitation, and hygiene facilities.

This change would have a profound impact on human health, economic development, and overall well-being. It would alleviate the suffering of millions of people, most of whom are women and children, who spend countless hours every day to fetch water for their families. It would also help to eradicate water-borne diseases, increase crop yields, and support sustainable food systems.

Furthermore, access to clean water would enable people to live more fulfilling and productive lives, allowing them to pursue their passions and contribute to their communities in meaningful ways.

It's a lofty goal, I know, but I believe it's a fundamental human right that should be universally available.
